text:
Maria G: Quick sync — timed-burst launch wireup for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages + webinar + inbound lead routing. Goal: staggered posts, clear benchmark narratives for landing pages, webinar as conversion anchor, and explicit HubSpot routing. Who owns copy, who owns routing?
Sam P: I can own copy variants for Hosted + Dedicated. Will pair with Tess on Private.
Tess: I can own Private copy and the legal-friendly variant.
Leo O: I'll own inbound forms → HubSpot mappings + lead tags. Need final form fields.
Maria G: Draft cadence below, open to swaps. Also need benchmark one-pager and webinar subject lines. Paste schedule:
```
Week 1:
- Mon AM: Hosted announcement (short post + link)
- Wed AM: Dedicated deep-dive (benchmark thread + perf highlights)
- Thu PM: Webinar invite (Hosted/Dedicated focus)
Week 2:
- Tue AM: Private use-case post (reg & compliance angle)
- Wed PM: Release notes + benchmark highlights recap
Webinar: Thu 11:00 PT
```
Sam P: Suggest moving Dedicated to Tue to avoid partner content clash. Also need 2 subject lines + 3 CTAs for webinar registration.
Tess: For Private copy, emphasize VPC controls, KMS/HSM, audit logs. I'll draft a technical and a compliance-friendly version.
Leo O: Proposed form fields: name, email, company, role, deployment mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), primary use-case, region, model scale estimate. Add hidden utm + campaign tags.
Jordan (ops): I'll wire HubSpot flows: Hosted -> inbound-nurture-hosted, Dedicated -> enterprise-engage, Private -> sales-alert + account-ops. Will add lead scoring rule: role + company size + model-scale threshold.
Maria G: Benchmarks — Sam owns perf microbench + one-pager highlights; Tess owns compliance/enterprise narrative + copy snippets for Private. Need both short bullets for landing panels and a longer appendix for webinar.
Sam P: I'll produce 3 charts (latency vs QPS, cost/token by batch config, 95th-tail latency) + short methodology blurb and sample prompts. Will also include recommended quantization/ batching tradeoffs for callers.
Tess: I'll pull legal-safe phrasing and two persona blurbs (Platform Engineer - speed & cost; Security Lead - audit & KMS). Need sample customer quotes — can we use anonymized bench examples?
Leo O: For routing, recommend tag names: mode:hosted/dedicated/private, interest:webinar, benchmark_download:true. Also request a webhook to /internal/lead-events for ops.
Maria G: launch-bot, confirm webinar slot and registration page?
launch-bot: Reminder: webinar slot booked Thu 11:00 PT. Registration page created: https://redwood.ai/events/timed-burst-launch (internal path: /events/timed-burst-launch).
Sam P: Draft timeline for copy deliverables: Hosted draft by Fri, Dedicated & benchmarks by next Wed, Private drafts by next Thu.
Tess: Working on Private drafts — will loop in legal by EOD Tue.
Jordan (ops): I'll set up HubSpot forms + flows by Wed EOD; need final field list and GTM campaign tag.
Maria G: :thumbsup: Sync check — next meeting Tues 9:00am PT to review first drafts. Please drop copy into #marketing-drafts and ping me. Aim to go-live Week 1 Wed AM for Hosted.
Sam P: Got it, will drop Hosted draft today.
Tess: Got it — legal ping incoming.
Leo O: Routing set as blocker until we have exact form fields; will stand by.
Maria G: Thanks team — small checklist in thread: 1) copy drafts, 2) benchmark one-pager, 3) webinar reg page copy + 2 subject lines, 4) HubSpot wiring, 5) go-live asset links. I'll track in the launch doc.
Sam P: On it.
Tess: Will post Private copy variants later today.
Jordan (ops): Adding tasks to ops board now.
Maria G: Closing note — keep language consistent across Hosted/Dedicated/Private: benefits -> economic controls -> security guarantees. Short bullets on landing, long reads in webinar. Thanks! :sparkles:
